messages.text: Stroud stars as Texans finally win at home with defeat of Colts

metadata.summary: CJ Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home, defeating the Indianapolis Colts.
metadata.content: NFL: CJ Stroud stars as Houston Texans finally win at home this season with 26-3 defeat of Indianapolis Colts | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL: CJ Stroud stars as Houston Texans finally win at home this season with 26-3 defeat of Indianapolis Colts Houston Texans quarterback CJ Stroud throws for 194 yards and three touchdowns in 26-3 win vs Indianapolis Colts; Stroud picked apart Colts side missing injured starting cornerbacks Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward in first Texans home victory this season Friday 20 November 2026 07:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Indianapolis Colts against the Houston Texans CJ Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home, defeating the Indianapolis Colts. Stroud threw for 194 yards and three touchdowns as the Texans used a strong defensive performance to coast to a 26-3 win over the Colts. With the roof at Reliant Stadium open for the first time since 2024, the Texans won a home game for the first time this season after losing their first four. "To have a home game win is very good for us and exciting," Stroud said. "I think this is a start to something that we need to go on a run with." Who is NFL MVP favourite? messages.text: Russell fastest as rain limits running in Las Vegas GP practice

metadata.summary: Mercedes' George Russell topped Practice Two from Alpine's Pierre Gasly as rain limited running on the opening day of track action at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
metadata.content: Las Vegas GP: George Russell tops practice for Mercedes as rain limits running on first day of track action | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Las Vegas GP: George Russell tops practice for Mercedes as rain limits running on first day of track action George Russell topped second practice from Pierre Gasly after there was very little running in first practice on a wet first day of track action; watch the Las Vegas GP on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday By Nigel Chiu in Las Vegas Friday 20 November 2026 05:42, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from Thursday's practice sessions at the Las Vegas Grand Prix Mercedes' George Russell topped Practice Two from Alpine's Pierre Gasly as rain limited running on the opening day of track action at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. After no timed laps were completed in first practice due to heavy rain falling throughout, the weather relented to allow plenty of running during the second session, albeit on a damp, slowly drying circuit that prevented the use of slick tyres. The best lap times came at the end of the session, which took place on Thursday night in Las Vegas, when Russell pipped Gasly by 0.071s, with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc three tenths off the pace in third. metadata.content: Dillian Whyte offers to fight Deontay Wilder on December 11: ‘If Wilder wants it, they know where I am’ | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Dillian Whyte offers to fight Deontay Wilder on December 11: ‘If Wilder wants it, they know where I am’ Dillian Whyte has made himself available to step in for Jai Opetaia and box Deontay Wilder on the undercard of the December 11 fight between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff; "If they want it and they want to have a good fight, then I'm down," he said Thursday 19 November 2026 18:07, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Dillian Whyte says eight years after first calling him out he is still ready to face Deontay Wilder on the Fury v AJ undercard in Cardiff Dillian Whyte is ready to rekindle his rivalry with Deontay Wilder. At one point Whyte was the WBC's No 1 contender when Wilder held that title. He never got to box Wilder, though did eventually challenge Tyson Fury after he'd beaten the American for the belt. Wilder is currently looking for a new opponent after Jai Opetaia withdrew from a heavyweight bout that was scheduled for the undercard of Fury's December 11 showdown with Anthony Joshua . Whyte has made himself available as a replacement. "If they want it then they know where I am," the Brixton heavyweight told Sky Sports News . messages.text: Antonelli hit with grid penalty for Las Vegas GP

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli has received a five-place grid penalty for the Las Vegas Grand Prix after further exceeding his engine allocation for the season.
metadata.content: Las Vegas GP: Kimi Antonelli to serve grid penalty along with Oscar Piastri, Carlos Sainz, Lance Stroll, Oliver Bearman | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Las Vegas GP: Kimi Antonelli to serve grid penalty along with Oscar Piastri, Carlos Sainz, Lance Stroll, Oliver Bearman New Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli will serve a five-place grid penalty for the Las Vegas Grand Prix; watch the Las Vegas GP on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday Friday 20 November 2026 06:16, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Las Vegas Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli has received a five-place grid penalty for the Las Vegas Grand Prix after further exceeding his engine allocation for the season. New Formula 1 world champion Antonelli took his sixth internal combustion engine (ICE) of the season during Thursday's opening practice sessions in Las Vegas, breaching the limit of four across the year for the second time. Given the penalty for a second breach is five rather than 10 grid places, the Mercedes driver will start no higher than sixth in the race, which begins on Sunday morning at 4am UK time (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 .
